dedupe_keys.name: bay delta schism estuary model setup

description: Bay-Delta SCHISM is an open model setup for the San Francisco Bay and Sacramento–San Joaquin Delta estuary. The California Department of Water Resources and Virginia Institute of Marine Science apply the three-dimensional SCHISM hydrodynamic and water-quality code to flow, salinity, habitat and conveyance questions. The repository contains scripts, mesh and bathymetry preparation, templates, tests and input-data organisation for this regional application. Users configure ocean and river boundaries, operations, mesh and simulation dates; outputs can include water levels, velocity, salinity and transport fields over the Bay-Delta. The project aims at multiyear runs with finer focus regions where needed, not a single fixed resolution. Code is free under Apache-2.0, with public workflow documentation. A limitation is that the project page says calibration and mechanisms vary by application; the base setup is not validation for every fish, mercury or barrier question. This model can test estuary conveyance and drought-barrier options. The catalogue's data-opendelve-global-delta-levees is a separate delta-context resource, not an input shown here. No mesh, dataset or model package was downloaded.
